$comment: UI routing-quality contract. Each scenario maps a realistic UI task intent to the ui-kit resources that MUST surface in the top-K when the agent calls search_ui_kit_resources. The gate runner verifies every expectation by building the UI index with the same shared core the runtime tool uses (kit-ui-router-core.ts) and scoring with the exact shared runtime scoring (kit-resource-router-scoring.ts), so the gate and the agent cannot diverge. offDomain: true means the query must be rejected as outside the UI SDK (empty-over-noise rule) — used for Go-only intents that must never surface UI resources. The product validator also checks this file's schema and id linkage node-free; expected ids must be produced by the UI index builder (skills: frontmatter name; rules/patterns/ux/docs: filename stem; components-index).
